uncited: - **Input:** A pre-trained NeRF model (MLP parameters), a source image $I_{src}$ (optional, for relative loss), a target text prompt $t_{tgt}$, and a source text prompt $t_{src}$ (optional).
- **Output:** Updated NeRF parameters that stylize the rendered views to match the semantic direction of $t_{tgt}$ relative to $t_{src}$ or absolute style.
- **NeRF Model:** Standard MLP mapping 3D coordinates and viewing directions to color and density.
Parameters are split into density-related and color-related sub-parameters.
Takes an image or text and outputs a normalized embedding vector.
- **Patch Buffer:** Stores rendered pixel values for a $128 \times 128$ patch.
**Render Patch:** Render a $128 \times 128$ patch from the sampled pose.
**Compute Loss:** Calculate the loss based on the chosen directional strategy (see Formulas).
- **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of iterations (500) and the number of rays sampled per patch.
Patch rendering is significantly faster than full-image rendering.
- **Memory Complexity:** Proportional to the patch size ($128 \times 128$) and sampling points (80 per ray), rather than full image resolution.
It extends the StyleCLIP [Patashnik et al. 2021] and StyleGAN-NADA [Gal et al. 2021] concepts to 3D neural radiance fields.
